name: The other metals
description: Cobalt, zinc, nickel and Mond's carbonyl, the porphyry chain (copper, molybdenum and the rhenium hiding in it), tungsten, chromium, tin, titanium, the silver in lead, zirconium and hafnium, beryllium, aluminium, lithium, uranium, graphite, antimony, niobium and tantalum, potash and gold, silicon from quartz to wafer, and germanium, indium, gallium and cadmium.
